title: Independent setters for nudge/nudgeSplit allow inconsistent state DoS; nudgeSplit==100 bypasses phlimbo.collectReward hook
justification: Inconsistent state reachable by single owner setter; reverts so no theft. nudgeSplit==100 bypassing collectReward(0) is an accounting-hook concern but compounds DEDUP-20/01 rather than introducing a separate vector. Low per C4 'state handling'.
